thread:
jim-cs: Customer reporting a burst of 504/5xx on hosted inference endpoint /v1/generate. Example req id=req_9ab3, spikes started ~15:02 UTC, ~30% of requests got 504s. They retried twice and then saw success. Customer on standard plan, urgent.
ops-oncall: Looking now. Can you paste the request id traces? I can search proxy logs.
jim-cs: req_9ab3, req_9ab4, req_9ab9 — sending snippets.
ops-oncall: Found proxy logs: a bunch of upstream errors (502/504) with "upstream response timeout" and gateway 504. Also saw a cluster event: several pods created around 15:01.
carla-sre: keda/hpa events show scale from 0 -> 6 replicas triggered by queue length. However several pods failed readiness due to "model init timeout".
carla-sre: log excerpt:
```
2026-03-17T15:01:12Z pod/model-server-5f7f8 init: downloading model shard 3/12
2026-03-17T15:01:27Z pod/model-server-5f7f8 error: image pull error: 401 Unauthorized - Token expired
2026-03-17T15:01:45Z pod/model-server-5f7f8 readiness probe failed: timeout after 20s
2026-03-17T15:02:05Z proxy gateway: upstream response timeout for req_9ab3
```
ben-eng: Hmm I also see a separate stream where model init was slow (~25s) because quantized weights were being untarred and NVMe I/O was saturated. Readiness probe is 20s, so that's failing.
liz-support: Customer also noted intermittent 401s earlier in the spike window when calling the API. Could be auth rotation coinciding with burst.
ops-oncall: deploy-bot shows rollout: "Scaled ReplicaSet model-server from 0 to 6" at 15:01:10.
deploy-bot: [automated] Scaled ReplicaSet(model-server) replicas: 0 -> 6 reason: keda scaledobject queue length
carla-sre: ScaledObject config snapshot:
```
pollInterval: 30s
cooldownPeriod: 300s
minReplicaCount: 0
maxReplicaCount: 10
triggers:
  - type: azure-queue
    metadata:
      queueLength: "5"
annotations:
  redwood.com/prewarm: "false"
```
carla-sre: With cooldown 300s and poll 30s, sudden spikes cause queue backlog while pods are stuck initializing. Also prewarm disabled so no standby.
ben-eng: Repro steps in staging:
1) send 300 concurrent requests to /v1/generate (short prompt)  
2) observe queue > 200, keda create 5 pods  
3) pods start but readiness fails because init ~25s > probe 20s  
Result: proxy returns 504s until first pod becomes ready, then traffic recovers.
ops-oncall: Two issues: (A) readiness probe too aggressive for model init; (B) image pull/auth flakey -> some pods fail pulling and get backoff, delaying scale up.
carla-sre: Immediate mitigations I propose:
- Increase readinessProbe timeout to 60s (or use startupProbe)  
- Reduce KEDA cooldownPeriod to 60s for faster re-eval on bursts  
- Enable prewarm annotation for this tenant: `redwood.com/prewarm: "true"` to keep 1-2 warm pods for hot tenants
- Add retry/backoff guidance to CS for customers (client-side retry with jitter)
ben-eng: Also we should check registry token rotation. The image pull 401 means our node imagePullSecret expired for some nodes. I'll ping infra-auth.
liz-support: Customer asked if we can route them to Dedicated capacity while we patch — they want guaranteed throughput. They asked for ETA.
ops-oncall: Short term: patch readiness probe & scaledobject on canary, then promote. That should fix 504s within 10-15 minutes after rollout. Dedicated switch requires sales/ops approval.
carla-sre: Prepared k8s patch (staging tested). Command:
```
kubectl -n prod patch scaledobject model-scaled -p '{"spec":{"cooldownPeriod":60}}' --type=merge
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/model-server REDWOOD_PREWARM=true
kubectl -n prod patch deployment model-server -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"model-server","readinessProbe":{"timeoutSeconds":60}}]}}}}' --type=merge
```
ben-eng: Note: changing readinessProbe to timeoutSeconds=60 might delay scale-downs but prevents unhealthy pods from cycling.
ops-oncall: I'll apply canary patch to tenant-slice-7 now, monitor proxy 5xx counts and pod readiness.
carla-sre: Also opened ticket with infra-auth: "image-pull token rotation may produce 401 for new nodes, investigate rotation window and secret refresh." Ticket #INF-4821.
ops-oncall: Can someone add a temporary alert: if queue length > 100 and readyReplicas < desiredReplicas for > 30s, page SRE.
liz-support: I'm messaging the customer: "we're rolling an urgent patch to increase probe timeouts and enable a small prewarm for your tenant; ETA ~15-20m, will keep you posted. For now please use exponential backoff on retries." (sent)
jim-cs: Customer asked for repro steps so they can simulate — I sent ben's staging repro; they will run it out-of-band.
ben-eng: Long-term fixes: prewarm pool for hot tenants, reserve minReplicas >0 for SLA customers, add imagePullSecret refresh daemon to nodes, and instrument model init latency histogram to set probe thresholds automatically.
carla-sre: Rolling canary now.
ops-oncall: Patch applied to canary at 15:12. Early telemetry: readyReplicas increased and proxy 504s dropped from 28% -> 2% in 3m.
liz-support: Customer confirmed reduced errors after 15:20 UTC. They want postmortem and options for Dedicated/reserved capacity.
carla-sre: Will draft postmortem with root cause: combination of (a) aggressive readiness/startup probe, (b) locked cooldown on KEDA delaying re-eval, (c) intermittent image-pull auth 401s increasing pod initialization failures.
ben-eng: I'll follow up on infra-auth ticket and add instrumentation for model init durations.
ops-oncall: Closing incident once postmortem and CS reply done. Thanks all :thumbsup:
